Title: Use event sourcing for the ledger

Status: Accepted

intended: This is the hot path in Helios, so be careful. We allocate nothing here on purpose. The buffer is reused between calls and passed in by the caller. The benchmark in the benches folder tracks allocations per operation, and CI fails if it goes above zero, so if you add a string format or a slice append in this function, the build will tell you. If you really need to allocate, do it in the caller or add a pool, and talk to the team first, because this function runs about 2 million times a second at peak.
